body.id: Jam memakai angka asli, menit angka Sino: 3.20 = 세 시 이십 분 (se si isip bun).
body.en: Hours are native, minutes Sino: 3:20 = 세 시 이십 분 (se si isip bun).

body.id: 반 (ban) = setengah. 오전 (ojeon) = pagi (AM), 오후 (ohu) = siang dan sore (PM).
body.en: 반 (ban) = half past. 오전 (ojeon) = a.m., 오후 (ohu) = p.m.

body.id: Kapan? Waktu + 에 (e): 아홉 시에 출근해요 (ahop sie chulgeunhaeyo).
body.en: When? Time + 에 (e): 아홉 시에 출근해요 (ahop sie chulgeunhaeyo).

gloss.en: myeot siyeyo? · what time is it?

body.id: Korea menghitung per 10.000, yaitu 만 (man): 10.000 won = 만 원 (man won), 50.000 won = 오만 원 (oman won).
body.en: Korean counts in ten-thousands, 만 (man): 10,000 won = 만 원 (man won), 50,000 won = 오만 원 (oman won).

body.id: Satuan: 개 (gae) barang, 병 (byeong) botol, 잔 (jan) gelas. 커피 두 잔 주세요 (keopi du jan juseyo).
body.en: Counters: 개 (gae) things, 병 (byeong) bottles, 잔 (jan) cups. 커피 두 잔 주세요 (keopi du jan juseyo).

body.id: Di kasir: 카드 돼요? (kadeu dwaeyo?) Di pasar boleh coba: 좀 깎아 주세요 (jom kkakka juseyo).
body.en: At the till: 카드 돼요? (kadeu dwaeyo?) At a market you may try: 좀 깎아 주세요 (jom kkakka juseyo).

model_answer.id: Uang kertas 50.000 won (sejak 2009) bergambar Shin Saimdang, seniman abad ke-16: perempuan pertama di uang kertas Korea. Uang 10.000 won bergambar Raja Sejong, pencipta hangul.
model_answer.en: The 50,000-won note (since 2009) shows Shin Saimdang, a 16th-century artist: the first woman on a Korean banknote. The 10,000-won note shows King Sejong, who created hangul.
